title: Hub enforces membership + canSendMessage
description: v1 hub enforces §8.1 membership capabilities and canSendMessage; all other capabilities are encoded and carried but not enforced (many are client-side by nature).
notes: Superseded in part by mimid-1wgh.6.2 (2026-10-18): hub also enforces §8.6 and refuses GCE/PSK.
